principle: Prove one exact executable sleeve per market before expanding coverage.

us.execution_scope: US listed common stocks and REITs; long and selective short only where borrow proof exists; monthly/earnings-event decisions

idx.execution_scope: IDX cash equities; long-only until borrow/short-sale availability is independently proven

commodity.execution_scope: CME/NYMEX/COMEX futures sleeves: WTI crude, gold and copper; contract-specific, fully collateralized

fx.execution_scope: CME currency futures for EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD and CAD; no OTC proof transfer

crypto.execution_scope: BTC and ETH spot/perpetual on explicitly named Binance and Deribit accounts; venue-specific

promotion_levels.DATA_ADMITTED: All historical core roles pass point-in-time, identity and lineage checks.
promotion_levels.HISTORICAL_BLIND_PROVEN: Frozen model passes sealed OOS/lockbox, target calibration, extreme-winner or large-move benchmark, costs and drawdown.
promotion_levels.LIMITED_PRODUCTION_READY: Prospective shadow and small-capital execution receipts pass exact-scope gates.
promotion_levels.FULLY_PROVEN: At least 200 closed prospective trades, at least 24 months, at least four regimes, net PF >= 1.50, bootstrap PF lower bound >= 1.20, normal MDD <= 15%, stress MDD <= 20%.
